system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.music: Broad orchestral score: low brass swells and driving taiko-like percussion underneath the dive, resolving onto a sustained brass chord as the dragon rears and roars.
fragments.shot:shot-1:description: A wall of black smoke tears apart above a scorched battleground of shattered stone, sunken trenches and guttering ember fires. Through the breach bursts <Subject:subject-2>, wings spread to their full span, pale horns cutting the haze as the body tips into a steep dive toward the ruined field. Astride its shoulders, just behind the horns, <Subject:subject-1> leans low into the descent, her technical jacket snapping in the rush of air, one hand locked around a ridge of scale. Far below, broken banners and scattered armour glint in the ember light.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: The smoke wall splits and <Subject:subject-2> punches through into open air, membrane wings catching the updraft and throwing long shadows across the field.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: <Subject:subject-1> presses herself flat along the dragon's back, elbows tucked, chin down against the wind.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: Heavy wingbeats and a long rush of air swallow the distant din of battle.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: Wind lashes <Subject:subject-1>'s short hair across her brow as her face fills the frame beside the dark scaled curve of <Subject:subject-2>'s neck and the pale edge of a horn. Rain and grit bead on her cheek and along the faint linear mark there; the high collar of her tactical jacket rides against her jaw, straps and buckles rattling with each beat of the wings. Her eyes narrow and her jaw sets as concentration hardens into fierce resolve.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: Her expression tightens; the flicker of uncertainty drains away and something stubborn and bright takes its place.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: <Subject:subject-1> shifts her grip higher on the scaled ridge and braces her boots against the shoulder plates.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: A thin high whistle of wind past her ear, and a strap buckle tapping in quick rhythm.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The camera arcs around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.shot:shot-3:description: The dive bottoms out hard over the battleground: <Subject:subject-2> snaps its wings wide, drags the air into a braking flare, and slams down onto broken stone, claws skidding through rubble as the body rears and the horned head swings up to roar. <Subject:subject-1> stays low against its back, one arm hooked over the crest, jaw clenched against the shock. Smoke, embers and pulverised stone wash outward across the ruined field, and the scattered fires gutter sideways in the blast.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:0: <Subject:subject-2> flares both wings to their widest span, membranes taut, and drops the last of the altitude in a controlled plunge.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:1: Clawed limbs strike the stone; slabs crack and shear under the impact as the dragon rears up.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:2: A bellowing roar rolls across the field, followed by the grind of stone beneath clawed feet.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:3: Embers and pale dust wash past <Subject:subject-1>, who raises a forearm to shield her eyes and stares forward into the smoke.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:4: Battlefield clamour surges — shouts, metal, and rubble scattering across the ground.
fragments.shot:shot-3:event:5: The camera tracks with the subject with large amplitude at fast speed.
fragments.soundscape: Rushing wind and heavy wingbeats over a distant battle din, with crackling embers, grinding rubble and a deep draconic roar.

facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet with black dividers: a wide cinematic hero image at top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four detail close-ups at bottom.
The hero panel shows a lone figure standing on a wet exterior walkway or catwalk at night in visible rain, with metal railings, reflective wet ground, and blurred city building lights behind.
In the hero panel the figure stands upright with arms at the sides, body generally facing forward, and head turned toward the viewer's left.
The figure has short dark hair with close-cropped or shaved sides and a small topknot, a light-to-medium complexion, and a faint linear mark on one cheek.
The figure wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with visible straps and metal buckles, a dark undershirt, black cargo or tactical trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The middle-left panel labeled FRONT shows the same figure facing the camera in a full-body frontal view, arms hanging at the sides, against a dark studio background.
The middle-center panel labeled SIDE PROFILE shows the figure in profile facing the viewer's left, with the topknot and jacket profile visible.
The middle-right panel labeled BACK shows the figure from behind, displaying the jacket back, trousers, and boots.

The bottom row contains four close-up panels: FACE shows a head-and-shoulders portrait, JACKET COLLAR shows the collar and a strap buckle, HANDS shows two hands and forearms, and BOOTS shows black lace-up boots.
Visible text labels read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The hero image uses cool blue-grey rain and night tones with warm amber city lights, while the studio panels use low-key charcoal and black backgrounds with soft directional lighting.
The overall style is photorealistic cinematic character concept or reference photography with a dark, gritty tactical aesthetic.

limitations: The sheet is a still composite; it provides no evidence of motion, audio, or off-frame context.
Dark lighting and the small detail panels limit exact material textures and the precise nature of the mark on the cheek.

The top scene uses low-key lighting with mostly black and gray tones, orange ember highlights near the ground, and subtle blue-gray reflections on the dragon’s scales.
The lower panels show static reference views labeled as front, side profile, and rear, plus close-ups of the head, wing membrane, claw and foot, and scale detail.
The panels have dark neutral backgrounds and are arranged for design reference rather than continuous action.
Visible panel labels read: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, SCALE DETAIL.
The close-up panels emphasize layered dark scales with blue-gray sheen, bony horn texture, dark veined wing membranes, and curved pale claws.
